articles.title: Ceiling Collapse at Kennedy Center Fuels Debate Over Shutdown and Trump's Name
articles.summary: A ceiling chunk fell in the Kennedy Center's hallway, sparking fresh calls to close for renovations. The board, backed by Trump, wants a two-year shutdown, but critics say it's an excuse. No one was hurt.

articles.title: Masked 'Stop the Boats' Protesters Disrupt Port of Dover
articles.summary: Hundreds of masked men blocked roads at the Port of Dover, chanting 'stop the boats.' Police cleared them by noon, but local MP Mike Tapp is demanding answers. No arrests were made.

articles.title: Reform UK's 'Pirate Ship' Culture Under Fire After Donations Scandal
articles.summary: A Channel 4 undercover video cost two Reform UK figures their jobs. Insiders worry the party's 'cavalier' culture is hurting its image. Leader Nigel Farage denies any pattern of law-breaking.
